title: Seen a few posts asking about Fable 5.2, as for visuals it is very impressive and has enhanced my map a lot - here are some before and after shots after I let Fable enhance and improve my map
author: W3103_
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/j0oi8jaxq01i1.jpeg

https://i.redd.it/qukzzskyq01i1.jpeg

![img](y6sfow1ar01i1 "Don't roast me, I've never made a game and am a total hobbyist ,  just wanted to share my experience with Fable so far, seen so many posts asking about its capabilities. Yes it's hungry for tokens but I have an ultra plan so haven't used them all up yet")

comments.author: W3103_
comments.body: I have seen a few posts.

comments.author: Mission_Bullfrog3294
comments.body: Very cool would love to hear more about the prompt used and tech stack

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body: just posted to another fella but in case you didnt see it I have an acronym I use. AEIOU, I ask it to Adapt, Enhance, Improve, Overhaul and Upgrade in every way

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: I'm mostly worried Fable will eat my $20 sub for breakfast

replies.author: svdomer09
replies.body: It will. It ate my $200 Max subscription in a couple days

replies.author: svdomer09
replies.body: Extra. Was working on some tricky game physics

comments.author: Project_Asura
comments.body: Which model did you used for the before?

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body: Opus 5.5 on high. It just really struggled on textures for me as you can tell by those gloopy cliffs, this has been an incredible upgrade so far. This was Fable 5.2 on ultracode

comments.author: TheRadishBros
comments.body: Holyyy- what did you ask Claude to do? Just “look at my art assets and make them better”?

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body: Pretty much, I have an acronym I use. AEIOU, I ask it to Adapt, Enhance, Improve, Overhaul and Upgrade in every way. Then I also told it the issues I had, texturing on the rocks, barren land, it didn’t feel alive, lighting was poor etc

comments.author: proudfather1986
comments.body: How much does fable 5.2 eat into a $20 package and is that a browser game? I’ve considered it for my game but only if I can do it in browsers.

replies.author: Academic-Lobster1323
replies.body: one 5 hour window will take the whole week

replies.author: proudfather1986
replies.body: Would be awesome if it could redo my entire game.
